chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from al-Mufaḍḍal ibn Ṣāliḥ, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning His saying:
My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house as a believer.
Meaning the wilayah. Whoever enters into the wilayah enters into the house of the Prophets عليهم السلام.
Indeed, Allah only desires to remove defilement from you, O Ahl al-Bayt, and to purify you with a thorough purification.
Meaning the Imams عليهم السلام and their wilayah. Whoever enters into it enters into the house of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: the People of the House, identified here with the Imams عليهم السلام
key_terms.الرِّجْسَ: defilement or impurity removed by Allah from Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةَ: the Imams عليهم السلام, intended in the explanatory sense of the narration
key_terms.الْوَلَايَةَ: the divinely ordained authority and guardianship associated with the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.بَيْتِ النَّبِيِّ: the house of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله, entered through acceptance of their wilayah
key_terms.بَيْتِيَ: my house; interpreted here as the house of the Prophets عليهم السلام through wilayah
key_terms.مُؤْمِنًا: as a believer; explained here in connection with entering the wilayah

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith interpret entering the house of the Prophets and the verse of purification in relation to wilayah?
ai.summary: This narration presents a tafsir of two Qur'anic passages through the lens of wilayah. It explains that true entry into the 'house' mentioned in the verse is entry into the wilayah, and that the purification verse refers to the Imams عليهم السلام and their divinely ordained authority. The report thus connects belief, Ahl al-Bayt, and prophetic household membership through adherence to wilayah.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Muhammad Bin Ali Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of the Mighty and Majestic
[71:28] My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who enters my house believing
– Meaning the Wilayah. The one who enteres into the Wilayah enters into the House of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>’.
[33:33] But rather, Allah Desires to Keep away the uncleanness from you, O people of the House! And to Purify you a with a Purification
– Meaning the Imams<sup>asws</sup> and their<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah. The one who enters into it, enters into the House of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>’.
